description: 1. Agent reads TASK.md to discover the local mock API endpoints (GET /docs/<id>, POST /docs/<id>/update, GET /docs/<id>/url). 2. Agent GETs the existing document to inspect its 6 original blocks and their block_ids. 3. Agent reads raw_proposal_draft.txt — a messy, informal chat-style Chinese text. 4. Agent transforms the chat draft into a formal proposal section: removes chat-tone language ('大家觉得呢', '挺靠谱', etc.), builds structured headings, and ensures the section is self-contained with background context. 5. Agent POSTs to /docs/doc_onboarding_2024/update using mode='append' (or 'insert_after') — NOT 'overwrite' or 'replace_all' — to preserve the original 6 blocks while adding the new proposal section at the end. 6. The new blocks include ≥2 heading blocks, formal language, and cover the key proposal elements (auto-summarization, Chinese medical records, fine-tuning, ROUGE evaluation, 6-month timeline, 20万 budget, ACL paper target). 7. Agent GETs the document URL and outputs it in a file or log, completing the link-delivery requirement. The proprietary trap: a naive agent would use 'overwrite' mode (destroying original content) or skip fetching the existing document before updating. The skill explicitly mandates non-destructive incremental updates and mandatory link delivery.
